representative_scale.policy: One fixed scale, rebuild once; no scale search, no doubling PATH_N. Report timeout if budget exceeded.
representative_scale.configuration_check: Printed Number of GPUs=1, Total number of options=1048576, Number of paths=262144; reject tiny-GPU reduction.

inputs.name: European call option parameters
inputs.access_instructions: Pinned executable generates parameters internally with srand(123) and randFloat.

inputs.name: Monte Carlo Gaussian draws
inputs.access_instructions: Pinned CUDA kernel generates samples with cuRAND normal RNG using source-defined initialization.

outputs.interface: Executable stdout plus process exit status

scoring.acceptance: Average reserve > 1.0, with Test passed and success exit status
scoring.reserve: Sum Confidence/abs(BS-MC) only for abs(BS-MC)>1e-6, divided by full option count
scoring.reason: Upstream publishes no numeric expected L1 or L1 acceptance threshold.
scoring.printed_boundary: Reserve prints six decimal places; use verdict or unrounded statistic for strict boundary.
scoring.performance: Streamed Total time (ms.), lower is better; Options per sec. is derived

outputs.artifact_paths_reason: Upstream command writes stdout, no published output artifact filenames.

anchor_validation.note: Published-scale acceptance check separate from fixed representative timing workload; both anchors share predicate.

budget_evidence.reason: No workload executed during intake. No evidence guarantees this fixed scale finishes within budgets; enforce stage deadlines and report timeout.

repeatability.gpu_rng: curand_init(blockIdx.x + gridDim.x * device_id, threadIdx.x, 0, ...); no seed CLI
repeatability.reason: No published repeat count or timing aggregation rule in brief or fetched sources; GPU geometry changes random streams, GPU Boost changes performance.
